newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to meet Georgian, Azerbaijani leaders.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to meet Georgian, Azerbaijani leaders.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton will meet Georgian President Eduard Shevardnadze at the White House on July 18, the White House announced on Tuesday.
"The two leaders will exchange views on U.S.-Georgian bilateral relations and issues of regional concern," White House spokesman Mike McCurry said.
He also announced that Clinton would meet President Haydar Aliyev of Azerbaijan at the White House on Aug. 1 for talks on development of Caspian energy resources.
